**Finding: missing** (rule IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data)

The MSA has no IP ownership provision at all. The only proprietary-rights language is § 14(b) (p0065), limited to names, trademarks and logos, plus AP's own warranty that it owns its Content and Properties (p0043). Deliverables/"products delivered hereunder" appear only in Kubient's warranties (p0033, p0040) with no ownership or licence-back, and nothing addresses ownership of AP's Content, Properties, Inventory or Requests data.

Nothing assigns AP IP or data to Kubient, so this isn't walk-away territory — but the rule expects a clause and none exists. I proposed (validated ok:true) a new Section 14 inserted after the Disclaimer: AP retains all rights in Customer Data; Kubient retains the Auction Platform and pre-existing tools; AP owns deliverables with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any embedded Kubient IP; no joint ownership.
